decisions.reason: The biodynamic natural yogurt fits the firm's established organic dairy range and was still featured a year after launch, suggesting normal continuity rather than withdrawal.
A newly launched mild sliced cheese on its own product page indicates an active rollout in a core dairy category, so the firm would likely give it more time in the market.
The sliced butter cheese is also a fresh 2024 launch with dedicated presentation and strong overlap with the firm's core cheese business, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.
